name: kit
description: Blocks destructive commands, runs your project's own checks before Claude says done, and starts every session knowing your stack: guard hooks, a formatter and sanitizer, /audit, /code, /write, /pr, /deps and /meta, stack pattern skills, and review agents.

precedence.title: Kit rules take precedence
precedence.description: Add a system-prompt section saying the kit's rules and kit: hook context outrank default, mode, and built-in skill instructions where they conflict.

kit_stats.title: /kit-stats command
kit_stats.description: Add a /kit-stats command that prints kit stats: blocks, shadow blocks, and skips per rule, and the claims each checker flagged.

subagent_rows.title: Subagent rows
subagent_rows.description: Draw each subagent row as its name with a (+N) count of agents below it, status, model, effort, context, elapsed time, and the tool it is running or its latest progress note.
